title: epistemic-inertial-calibration: Three Layers of Active Inertial Self-Calibration
description: Simulation code and reproducibility artifacts for the manuscript "Active Inertial Self-Calibration Beyond Identifiability: Task-Compatible Excitation and Terminal Feasibility," prepared for submission to Robotics and Autonomous Systems. The final S5 pipeline includes planar 2R/4R base-subspace analysis, executable excitation-policy comparisons, task-compatible null-space excitation, terminal-feasibility diagnostics, and a KUKA LBR iiwa 7-DoF generalization.
